| [Monthly retrospective](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Runs the department's monthly retrospective so that it ends in exactly one decided adjustment, not a list. Closes last month's change first, gathers the three inputs (incidents, metrics, COP feedback with the historical ODEC record), lists what was learned with its evidence, picks the one change, and records who decides it and how it will be checked next month. Use when the monthly retro is due, after a COP round, an incident or a missed threshold, or when someone asks what the improvement loop is and why a retro that produced a list has not produced a decision. Not for preparing the COP round (metrics-scorecard) or reading the risk register (dept-risk). |
